assign.outcome:
**`children` may be a function now — the seam is in core, and two pages stopped hand-writing it.** A page can answer `children` with a function that returns a promise, and core calls it once, on the first ask. That is the owner's own sentence of 2026-09-17 — *pages are everything, and they don't have to be real paths* — applied to the proposal that had been waiting for exactly that since 2026-09-13.

**In core** — 33 lines into `Page.class.js`, 8 of them code (820 → 845). `declare(list)` takes the declaration as an argument and stores a function as `child_source`; [`source_children()`](/framework/core/Page/api/source_children/) calls it once, memoised; `child()` and `load_all_children()` await it, the second with core's own guard already above the await. A string, array, POJO or `Page`-object `children:` behaves exactly as before, and a page that declares no function never reaches the new branch. Seam 2, a core `redraw()`, stays refuted.

**Out of the two callers** — 87 lines out, 35 back: **52 fewer**. [Make](/imagine/paging/make/) 636 → 615, [JSON pages](/imagine/cms/json/) 93 → 62. Both dropped their `child()` and `load_all_children()` overrides and the copy of core's guard that both had once shipped without.

**Proof** — the [18 urls](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/core-data-children/18-urls.json) the proposal names answered **identically** before and after: same document titles, same page-title lists, same link sets, same page counts, same console errors. Cold deep urls into both trees with the cache disabled, plus three in-app hops each: **zero** "Chaining cycle detected for promise". Site crawl of `/framework/` + `/notes/`: **630 urls before, 630 after, zero new failures** — 274 console-error pages before, 271 after, 257 of them the `core/new/1` sandbox that errors by design. The one url that differed re-ran clean immediately; a sibling minion was appending to `/framework/ai/` during the run.

**Docs** — [`data-children.md`](/framework/core/Page/doc/data-children/) opens with the applied line and the numbers · [`decisions.md`](/framework/core/Page/doc/decisions/) carries the dated record · the [readme](/framework/core/Page/)'s Use block shows the form · `declare`, `child`, `load_all_children` and the `children` property updated, and [`source_children`](/framework/core/Page/api/source_children/) is a new member page.

**Left, and why** — `/imagine/paging/doc/persistence.md` still describes the two hand-written overrides as current: true until today, but outside this task's fence. `/imagine/cms/page.js` declares a `welcome` child with no `page.js` behind it, so every `/imagine/cms/` url logs one 404 — pre-existing, present in both runs, outside the fence. No new demo page: the two live callers are the demonstration, and a `core/Page/overview/` demo must not touch the network.
